title: Dirichlet--Neumann waveform relaxation for heterogeneous heat equations: fully discrete $l^2$ analysis
summary: We consider two coupled linear heat equations on different spatial domains that interact through a lower dimensional interface. This models conjugate heat transfer. The problem is solved using Dirichlet--Neumann waveform relaxation. This allows the subproblems to be solved using separate codes, a so called partitioned approach. Our overall goal is to develop more efficient partitioned methods, and to this end, we want reliable error estimates. Here, we use an exponentially weighted Fourier technique to derive new error estimates in $l^2$ for finite time $T$ in the fully discrete setting.…
